name: Mark
purpose: Render a semantically marked static passage with restrained theme-aware Brick paint.
useWhen: Authored content needs a static marked passage whose relevance is already known.

avoidWhen.condition: Text must be matched from a query.

composition: Keep Mark inside the surrounding Text, heading, link, or Prose content owner.

rules.statement: Use Mark for authored static relevance; do not pass a query or implement search matching inside it.
Preserve the one native mark host and select only the documented variant and tone recipes.
Load styles.css or core.css plus mark.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Mapping every search result manually through Mark.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Highlight when Atom-owned matching must segment text.

validation: Confirm native mark semantics, normal selection and copy, inherited typography, readable contrast, wrapping, forced colors, zoom, RTL, and CSS delivery.
